name: Mishma
title: Son of Ishmael
summary: Mishma was one of the twelve sons of Ishmael, Abraham's son through Hagar. He became the ancestor of one of the twelve Ishmaelite tribes. His name is also mentioned in the genealogy of Simeon in 1 Chronicles, where a descendant line with the same name appears.

keyEvents.title: The Sons of Ishmael Mentioned
keyEvents.description: Mishma is listed as one of the twelve sons of Ishmael, who became fathers of twelve tribes, in accordance with God's promise to Abraham that Ishmael would become a great nation.

keyEvents.title: Ishmael's Genealogy in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Mishma is mentioned again as a son of Ishmael in the genealogical record in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Mishma in the Genealogy of Simeon
keyEvents.description: A person named Mishma appears in the tribal genealogy of Simeon as a son of Hammuel, which may suggest a connection or naming tradition between the tribes.

keyEvents.title: God's Promise Regarding Ishmael
keyEvents.description: God promised Abraham that Ishmael would be the father of twelve princes and become a great nation. Mishma was one fulfillment of this promise.

keyEvents.title: The Death and Descendants of Ishmael
keyEvents.description: After the twelve sons of Ishmael, including Meshma, are listed, it is told that they settled from Havilah to Shur, east of Egypt.
